data.title: Bahrain Strongly Condemns Continued Houthi Terrorist Attacks on Riyadh
data.content:
Manama, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Kingdom of Bahrain strongly condemned the continued terrorist attacks by the Houthi terrorist militia on Riyadh, which caused material damage to a tower in the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD). It described the attacks as a flagrant violation of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty and of international law and international humanitarian law. Bahrain also warned that the attacks pose a serious threat to regional security and stability.
    In a statement, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs reaffirmed Bahrain's full solidarity with Saudi Arabia and its full support for all measures the Kingdom has taken to safeguard its sovereignty, security, and stability. These measures include protecting its national assets and ensuring the safety of its citizens and residents. The ministry also affirmed Saudi Arabia's legitimate right to self-defense under Article 51 of the United Nations Charter.
    The ministry reiterated Bahrain's call on the United Nations Security Council to fulfill its responsibilities and take firm, deterrent measures to halt the repeated Houthi terrorist attacks and hold their perpetrators and supporters accountable. It also called for ensuring the implementation of relevant Security Council resolutions, particularly Resolutions 2216, 2817, and 2837, to protect civilians and civilian, economic, and vital facilities and safeguard security and stability in the region and worldwide.
    -- SPA
